svg.text: AI-Native Investment Operating System — Comprehensive UI/UX Case Study
Role: Principal Product & UX Designer Timeline: 8 Weeks Tools: Figma, Illustrator, React, Zustand

text.tspan: AI-Native Investment Operating System for every Indian investor — trader and beginner
Two very different users, failed by the same fragmented market — power traders lose
the edge to latency and tool-switching; everyday investors are locked out of
Core insight: both audiences are underserved by the same root cause — no shared
intelligence layer connecting news, data and decisions in real time.
Mixed-methods research over 8 weeks: contextual interviews, a broad survey and diary
studies tracking real trading and investing decisions.
"By the time I've checked news, charts and my broker, the setup is gone."
"I want someone to explain WHY a stock moved today, in plain English."
"I need a dashboard that reacts the instant a breakout happens."
"I want to know if a stock is healthy before I invest my savings."
"If I miss this candle close, I miss the
"Just tell me what changed, and why."
HMW get order-routing latency under 20ms without overwhelming the screen?
HMW make fundamental analysis feel trustworthy and free, not "freemium bait"?
HMW turn a wall of news into a 10-second, personalised brief?
HMW give the AI copilot enough context to be genuinely useful?
Research clusters into five design pillars that guide every downstream decision:
Reads chart, positions & news before it
Free personalised "what this means for you"
Full indicator suite unlocked for every user.
Free TA & FA + AI news brief
Guardrail branch: if drawdown limit exceeded, execution is blocked and an alert banner fires
before the order reaches the broker.
New investors default to Simple Mode with guided tooltips; traders can switch to Pro Mode at
Structuring the three-zone workspace before any pixels are committed: watchlist context,
primary chart canvas, and a persistent AI rail.
Issue: UI lag on rapid buy/sell clicks during volatility spikes.
Fix: pre-fetched order-book state via persistent WebSocket.
Issue: first-time investors abandoned the dense FA screen.
Fix: AI one-line health summary pinned above the data table.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all data-critical text.
Buy/Sell colour paired with icon + label, never colour alone.
Full keyboard navigation for order entry and Copilot chat.
Vite + React 19 + TypeScript, Zustand slices (Watchlist, Portfolio, Intelligence).
WebSocket streaming via broker SmartAPI, dynamic port resolution dev <-> Electron.
RAG pipeline grounds Copilot + news in live chart, portfolio & licensed feeds.
Server-side portfolio store validates every order before it reaches the broker.
Validated across the 8-week pilot with 27 active pilot users spanning both trader and
Web + desktop launch, Free/Plus/Pro tiers, AI Copilot v1, watchlist & journal.
Mobile app parity, voice-driven Copilot queries, social sentiment signals.
Algo strategy builder (Elite), broker marketplace, regional languages.
V4.0 engineering upgrade: a pluggable, resilient market-data ingestion engine feeding the
whole TradeX Pro X experience — from charts to the AI Copilot.
BaseMarketProvider contract; SimulatorProvider for sandbox testing; SmartApiProvider wrapping live Angel One
Normalize -> Timestamp Validate -> Duplicate Filter -> Sequence-Gap Detection with historical candle replay
-> 100ms Latency-Optimizer batching to protect the React render thread.
Auto fail-over to simulation feed if packet loss > 15% or latency > 300ms; active RTT pings to
Status-bar footer (provider, latency, tick rate, connection badge) plus a diagnostics panel dock for packet
counts, drops and manual routing overrides.
get_market_pipeline_health exposes live pipeline status directly to the AI Copilot so it never reasons over
